takeaways.text: Runs a route on **100%** of dropbacks — about the WR average (100%). Effectively always a receiver; blocking is negligible.
On routes, averages **10.4 yd** downfield by the throw (n=249, snap→release window only).
Primary alignment is Wide (outside) (80%); a coach might set the first coverage answer to that spot. This is a hypothesis from observed tendencies, not a proven assignment.

example_plays.why: closest to his median route depth (9.5 yd) — a normal rep
farthest from his median depth — an outlier, NOT representative
